# Generated by mods/cm_maps/tools/port_from_cm.py - do not edit by hand.
# Lifted from Construction Manager dev, cm_gov_triggers.txt.
# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.
#
# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_gov_site_is_naval, bcm_gov_site_blocks_land_governor, bcm_gov_site_can_take_governor, bcm_gov_site_eligible


# Root is the location. A site a land governor could never reach, which is exactly what the
# naval type is for: in_game/common/building_types/capital_buildings.txt:799-803.
bcm_gov_site_is_naval = {
	NOT = { is_connected_to_through_realm = owner.capital }
	is_overseas_for_owner = no
	is_port = yes
}

# Root is the location. local_governor's allow refuses a site holding a seljuk_mint:
# in_game/common/building_types/capital_buildings.txt:634-637.
bcm_gov_site_blocks_land_governor = {
	has_building = building_type:seljuk_mint
}

# Root is the location. Whether either vanilla governor type could ever stand here, whatever gets
# built first: the land type rides a road to the capital, which needs the land or strait connection
# (in_game/common/building_types/capital_buildings.txt:641), and refuses a blocked site; the naval
# type takes the port instead and wants that same connection absent (:799-803). A missing road is
# left out, since roads can be built.
bcm_gov_site_can_take_governor = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			is_connected_to_through_realm = owner.capital
			bcm_gov_site_blocks_land_governor = no
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { is_connected_to_through_realm = owner.capital }
			is_port = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root is the location. Mirrors both vanilla governor types, waiving the city rank and the road
# where the plan will build them:
# in_game/common/building_types/capital_buildings.txt local_governor :607, naval_governor :760.
# Expects the run's slot counters on the owner.
bcm_gov_site_eligible = {
	OR = {
		location_rank = location_rank:city # :620
		location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis # :621
		AND = {
			# Below city rank the plan has to found the town or the city first, which it only does
			# with Allow Preparing New Locations on. A rank on a good the do-not-urbanize list holds
			# is one to leave uncreated whatever the de-urbanizer is set to, which is why this is the
			# plain list test rather than bcm_location_deurbanize_would_undo below.
			owner = { exists = var:bcm_ab_gov_prepare_sites }
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
				location_rank = location_rank:town
			}
			# The Found City step, which the whole chain has to reach for a governor to stand here:
			# bcm_upgrade_town_to_city_building location_potential population >= 30 and
			# allow cannot_upgrade_location,
			# in_game/common/building_types/bcm_location_upgrade_buildings.txt:26 and :23.
			population >= 30
			modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = no
			bcm_location_rgo_blocks_urbanize = no
		}
	}
	NOT = { has_variable = bcm_gov_plan_ord }  # check-script: never set — CM's governor planner's ordering. Guarded by has_variable
	NOT = { bcm_location_deurbanize_would_undo = yes }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owner = { var:bcm_gov_land_left > 0 }  # check-script: never set — CM's governor planner's budget, read from bcm_gov_site_eligible — which this mod reaches only through the bcm_gov_valid_only branch above, so it is never evaluated here
			owner.capital != this # location_potential: :642
			bcm_gov_site_blocks_land_governor = no
			is_connected_to = owner.capital
			# With no road coming, a land governor needs the one already there:
			# location_potential has_road_to_capital, :641.
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { owner = { NOT = { exists = var:bcm_ab_gov_prepare_sites } } }
				has_road_to_capital = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			owner = { var:bcm_gov_naval_left > 0 }  # check-script: never set — CM's governor planner's budget, read from bcm_gov_site_eligible — which this mod reaches only through the bcm_gov_valid_only branch above, so it is never evaluated here
			bcm_gov_site_is_naval = yes
		}
	}
}
